lines.text: On that day the remnant will truly rely on the LORD, and a remnant of Jacob will return to the Mighty God.
The Lord tells His people in Zion not to fear Assyria, because His fury against them will soon subside.
The LORD of Hosts will brandish a whip against Assyria, as when He struck Midian at the rock of Horeb.
Assyria stores supplies at Michmash and will halt at Nob, shaking a fist at the hill of Samaria.
The Lord GOD of Hosts will cut down the tall trees, and Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
